title: Log an issue in Forma Build
intro: Let's log an issue in Forma Build, following the site QA procedure. Follow the blue cursor.
context: Sample procedure: every site issue needs a type, a location-first title, an assignee and a photo.

steps.label: Issues
steps.say: Open Issues from the left menu.

steps.label: Create issue
steps.say: Click Create issue at the top right.

steps.label: Issue type
steps.say: Pick the type. Site defects go under Quality, Defect.

steps.label: Title
steps.say: Title it location first, then the defect.

steps.label: Assigned to
steps.say: Assign it to the package manager for that area.
